works.body:
Hello, I’d love to commission art featuring Anne and her girlfriend Suki. They're very passionate lovers who fight very often in the ring which always ends in one of them knocked out. It's not rare for them to kiss in the middle of a sparring match as they love each other a lot! I'd love to see an image of Suki in her boxing outfit as she flirts with Anne right before a match by brushing her tail against the sheep's face while saying something like "You ready to lose to the sexy cat, Anne~?♡". Anne blushes a lot and is very flustered. I'd love to also see an image of Suki completely knocked out with a bruised belly as she shows a dazed smile with her tongue hanging out. Meanwhile, Anne steps on Suki's beaten belly and looks down on her with a flirting expression. Anne has stolen her girlfriend's mouthguard after a previous kiss and holds it between her lips as she teases Suki for losing. I'd also love to see both of them blushing a lot~

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1cWdUQAL-jbdaSxA5Snp1XnrJvANj4yL2?usp=sharing

I would love to request some cute art featuring Gaile and Kerplewy’s Selene. Even though Selene always maintains her confident and arrogant appearance around the younger fox, she secretly likes Gaile like an older sister and wants her to become stronger. She also behaves almost like a strict mentor figure with a soft heart. Gaile has a lot of respect for Selene and is absolutely starstruck that the more experienced fox wants to spend time teaching her, which she is incredibly grateful for. Would you be fine with me requesting two images? For the first image, I would like to see the climax of a boxing match where Selene knocks Gaile out in Round 7 with a punch to the stomach that makes her spit out her blue mouthguard. In the second, Gaile and Selene eat dinner afterwards. Gaile's extremely excited about their intense fight while Selene struggles to hide her happiness at Gaile's growth. For the dinner scene, you are free to give Gaile simple clothes of your own choice. ^^

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CANdpmczGB2xngivklARaoOxAqcEjv2r?usp=sharing

Heya! I would like to commission some art of my fennec fox character Gaile! She's a very cute, kind and upbeat rookie MMA fighter & boxer who compensates for her lack of experience with sheer grit, determination and fighting spirit. She often struggles in fights but never gives up until the battle is over and will always run around the ring cheering whenever she manages to win, no matter how beaten and exhausted she is~
You are free to draw her however you like ^^

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CANdpmczGB2xngivklARaoOxAqcEjv2r?usp=sharing
